DISCOVERY: checked homepage full mega-menu, sitemap.xml (all 7 departments), and the special-offers department's own group-menu slider (Offers / Gifting / Gift Cards tiles). The special-offers department (16 URLs in sitemap) contains exactly one page whose site-own taxonomy is Clearance: /shop/special-offers/clearance - confirmed via its embedded Livewire wire:snapshot: categoryIdent='clearance', h1='Clearance', on-page copy 'Explore our Clearance and secure special savings. Buy before it's gone!' - this is a genuine, permanently-labelled clearance/outlet listing, not a seasonal campaign. SALE VS CLEARANCE DECISIONS: /shop/special-offers/shop-all-offers ('Offers', categoryIdent='') is the generic sale/discounts hub - h1 'Offers', copy 'Discover our latest sale offers across all ranges...you'll find our very best deals here' - no permanence/outlet signal, explicitly a rollup of ALL current temporary promos (279 products) - EXCLUDED as generic Sale per brief's Clearance-vs-Sale test, not recorded as ambiguous since the page itself gives no clearance-style language at all. The other special-offers sub-pages (20-off-selected-cookware, 20-off-selected-cutlery-and-glassware, 20-off-selected-knives-and-boards, 3-utensils-for-10, 3-utensils-for-20, 10-off-selected-electricals, halloween-3-for-10, gifts-for-* , shop-all-gifting, shop-all-gift-cards) are all named/dated percent-off or seasonal/gift promos with no clearance signal - excluded outright, not opened individually beyond the sitemap listing since their slugs are unambiguous discount-campaign names. NOTE: /shop/special-offers/shop-all-clearance appears in the sitemap.xml but returns a genuine HTTP 404 (title 'Error 404 - Not Found', not a soft-404/200) - it is a dead/removed URL, not used; the canonical working Clearance PLP is /shop/special-offers/clearance. No sub-structure: the Clearance page's own group-menu slider lists only 'Offers / Gifting / Gift Cards' as sibling department tiles (not clearance children), so a single flat row is correct - no genuine Clearance > X sub-categories exist. SIBLING CHECK: ProCook India was extracted separately in an earlier batch for this project; this UK site's clearance structure was investigated independently on its own merits, not assumed to mirror India's.
